# dsh-plugin-hot-reload
标题、简介、图标和浏览器模块都按磁盘现读现发布：改完立即生效，不用重启 DSH。

A DeepSeek Harness bundle. It replaces three cached resolvers with plain filesystem
walks, so a plug

in's display metadata and browser module follow the package on disk
instead of a verdict cached for
the life of the process:
| Service | Why it is patched |
| `pluginPackages.metaOf` | The Host resolves `locale/*.json` and `icon.svg` through the Node ESM re

solver. A package whose export was added after its first read stays bare until restart. |
| `pluginM
anager.listBundles` | The plugin inventory calls the Host reader directly, so it needs the same disk

result even when the Host already produced a fallback. |
| `clientModules.resolveMeta` / `locatePkg
Json` | Verdicts are cached in `pkgMeta`, `null` included. Moving a linked package makes its browser
re cached in `pkgMeta`, `null` included. Moving a linked package makes its browser half disappear. |
Install it into a profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Editing another plugin's `locale/`, `icon.svg`, or manifest then needs only a page
refresh. Editing

this plugin's own `index.js`, or adding a new importable subpath
export, still needs a restart: Node
caches modules by URL.
